name: larkfield-health.members.list
description: List the household members the account holder may see: an adult account holder, minors they are guardian of, and members whose view or act grant to them is in force, each with relation to the subscriber, minor flag, enrolled plan years and the account holder's powers over that member. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.grants.list
description: List access grants the account holder may see: every grant of a member they are or guard, and the grants naming them for members they may still see; each with scope (view or act), expiry and state, plus the account holder's own approvals for grant changes. Optional member_id filter. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.plan.get
description: Read the plan year's benefits (deductible and out-of-pocket maximum per individual and family, 20% coinsurance, copays by category, services needing prior authorization, in-network rules, emergency cost sharing) and the accumulators of members the account holder may view, with each member's other-coverage status for that year; family totals only when every enrolled member that year is visible. Defaults to the current plan year. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.claims.list
description: List claims of members the account holder may view, as of the App's current time (due reviews and request expiries are shown as they stand now): lines, information requests, EOB versions and appeal window. Optional member_id and status filters. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.claims.get
description: Read one claim: provider, lines with services and outcomes, information requests with their expiry (23:59 local on the notice date plus 45 days), every EOB version with line amounts and totals, the appeal-filing window and deadline, appeals, and the account holder's approvals for it. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.pa.list
description: List prior authorizations of members the account holder may view, with status, requested and approved terms, units used, decision due date and overdue flag. Optional member_id and status filters. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.pa.get
description: Read one prior authorization: provider, service, requested and approved units and validity, units used, information requests, expedite request, decision due date and overdue flag, denial-notice date and appeal-filing deadline for a denied PA, covered submissions, appeals and the account holder's approvals for it. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.list
description: List appeals of members the account holder may view, with target, status, decision due date and overdue flag. Optional member_id and status filters. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.get
description: Read one appeal: target claim lines or PA, statements, information requests, decision due date, overdue flag, outcome and the account holder's approvals for it. No side effects.

name: larkfield-health.grants.change.preview
description: Preview granting view or act access to a member's records (action grant with member_id, grantee_id, scope and optional expires_at) or revoking a grant (action revoke with grant_id only). Only an adult member for their own records, or a guardian for a minor. Returns a token, the person who must confirm and the grant before and after. Stores nothing.

name: larkfield-health.coverage.cob.preview
description: Preview attesting a member's other health coverage for a plan year (none, other_secondary or other_primary), which answers that member's open other-coverage requests for that year. Returns info_not_requested when none is open. Stores nothing.

name: larkfield-health.claims.info.preview
description: Preview answering the accident question on one claim line (not_accident, accident or work_related). Returns info_not_requested when the line has no open accident request. Stores nothing.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.file.preview
description: Preview filing an internal appeal on a denied claim (its denied lines) or a denied PA, with a statement; expedited filing only for a denied PA with urgency attested. Shows the lines, the decision-due rule and the due date if filed now, and the filing deadline. Stores nothing.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.withdraw.preview
description: Preview withdrawing an open appeal; the target can be appealed again within its original window. Stores nothing.

name: larkfield-health.grants.change.confirm
description: Apply a previewed grant change: restate the preview's arguments and pass its token. Needs a user confirmation for that token from the account holder within 30 minutes (confirmation_required, confirmation_invalid); arguments or state that no longer reproduce the token return stale_preview.

name: larkfield-health.coverage.cob.confirm
description: Record the previewed other-coverage attestation with its token after a user confirmation within 30 minutes; answers the member's requests for that year still open at commit and adjudicates the claims that completes.

name: larkfield-health.claims.info.confirm
description: Record the previewed accident answer with its token after a user confirmation within 30 minutes; the claim is adjudicated when no request is left open.

name: larkfield-health.pa.request_expedite
description: Ask once for expedited review of a pending or info_requested PA, with an optional reason; the plan answers by event. duplicate_request for a second request, expedite_not_allowed in any other state.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.file.confirm
description: File the previewed appeal with its token after a user confirmation within 30 minutes. Checks authority, then the confirmation and the token's freshness, then appealability (not_appealable), an open appeal (duplicate_request), the 180-day window (appeal_window_closed) and expedite eligibility (expedite_not_allowed).

name: larkfield-health.appeals.add_statement
description: Add a statement to an open appeal; an appeal waiting for information returns to review. invalid_state once the appeal is decided or withdrawn.

name: larkfield-health.appeals.withdraw.confirm
description: Withdraw the previewed open appeal with its token after a user confirmation within 30 minutes.
